title: Group Anagrams
prompt:
Given a slice of lowercase words, group together the words that are anagrams of each other (they use exactly the same letters with the same counts). Return a Vec of groups, where each group is a Vec of owned Strings.

Signature: `fn group_anagrams(words: &[&str]) -> Vec<Vec<String>>`

The order of the groups and the order of words inside each group do not matter. Every input word must appear in exactly one group (duplicates stay duplicates).

Example:
  group_anagrams(&["listen", "pots", "silent", "stop", "tops", "cat"])
  -> [["listen", "silent"], ["pots", "stop", "tops"], ["cat"]]   (any order)
